thread:
Samira Khan (CS): ping 1 Avalanche Legal's EU (IE) pilot is failing. Their corp proxy NATs egress to a couple /29s. They need an allowlist + short throughput lift for a partner demo tomorrow. Renewal call in 7 days, marking high priority.
Devin Park (SE): can you paste the CIDRs and the QPS/duration they want? Any hard data residency constraints?
Samira Khan (CS): CIDRs: 203.0.113.96/29 and 198.51.100.128/29. They want eu-west-1 pin (Ireland). Request bump 30 -> 120 QPS for 48h around demo window. Must keep all customer data in EU.
Lina Gomez (Onboard): they hit burst protection in the dry-run and dropped to 429s. customer is worried. please set autorevoke and a 24h pre-expiry reminder. also add a brief note for renewal playbook.
Noah Reed (NetEng): we can add the prefixes to the edge allowlist, pin routing to eu-west-1 and tag expiry. low-risk. will tag `autorevoke:true` and queue revocation.
Devin Park (SE): i'll bias routing policies and KV locality to Ireland for the project. also recommend a soft safety cap at 160 QPS as a backstop.
Samira Khan (CS): ops payload (expiry RFC3339):
```
allowlist:
  - cidr: "203.0.113.96/29"
    note: "avalanche-legal demo temp"
  - cidr: "198.51.100.128/29"
    note: "avalanche-legal demo temp"
allowlist_expires: "2026-04-15T09:00:00Z"
rate_limits:
  project_id: "avalanche-legal-prod"
  qps: "120"
  duration: "48h"
region_pin: "eu-west-1"
autorevoke: "true"
reminder: "2026-04-14T09:00:00Z"
soft_limit: "160"
```
Lina Gomez (Onboard): ops: please add CRM tag `escalation-mitigated` if demo succeeds and ping renewal team.
Noah Reed (NetEng): applying change now, will smoke-test from IE edge.
ops-bot: Ticket CS-6233 created 1 "Avalanche Legal: IE allowlist + 48h QPS lift". Assignees: Noah Reed, Devin Park. ETA 20m.
Noah Reed (NetEng): applied and verified via simulated source IPs. firewall logs show accept for both CIDRs. autorevoke job queued. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: CS-6233 status -> done. reminder scheduled for 2026-04-14T09:00:00Z.
Lina Gomez (Onboard): customer confirmed demo success and reported stable p95 latency. Marked escalation mitigated in CRM.
Samira Khan (CS): great work. lowered renewal risk. i'll follow up with a 3-question post-demo survey about regional latency and integration flow. :thumbsup:
